import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet');p=pd.read_parquet('passages.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
print(w.year.isna().sum(), w.work_id.duplicated().sum(), (w.year<w.decade).sum())
w['yr']=w.year.fillna(w.decade+5)
w['late']=w.yr>=1876; w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages
print(w.groupby(['genre','late']).r.agg(['mean','size']).unstack())
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack(); return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()
print('est',est(w))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
grp=[x for _,x in w.groupby(['genre','late'])]
for i in range(2000):
  bs.append(est(pd.concat([x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for x in grp])))
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
# sensitivity
for nm,d in [('highconf',w[w.date_confidence=='high']),('noNaNyear',w[w.year.notna()]),('UK',w[w.origin=='UK']),('US',w[w.origin=='US']),('ed1',w[w.n_editions==1])]: print(nm,est(d))
print(w.groupby('decade').r.mean())
p['dt']=p.domains.apply(lambda x:'DISTANCE_TRAVEL' in list(x))
print(p.dt.sum(), w[c].sum())
print(p[p.dt].sort_values('confidence',ascending=False).passage_id.head(8).tolist())
"
